purpose: Resolve whether replacing the current additive model with a low-cost interaction architecture is justified for the severe tab-specific top-five ranking failures, while preserving impression-time availability and sparse categorical inputs.
query: Factorization Machines and DeepFM-style sparse feature interaction architectures for context-aware recommendation ranking, especially user-item-context interactions among categorical fields such as tab, hour, weekday, user ID, and video ID

purpose: Resolve whether the observed gap between acceptable GAUC and weak nDCG@5 in several tabs warrants changing the training objective rather than adding features or architecture, without changing the fixed evaluation metric.
query: Learning-to-rank objectives for implicit-feedback recommendation that improve top-k metrics such as nDCG@5 while maintaining within-user AUC or GAUC, including pairwise and listwise losses compared with binary cross-entropy
